map.选择身体部位和训练时长，一键生成随机拉伸方案，让每次拉伸都有新花样: Choose body parts and session length, then generate a random stretch routine in one click to keep every session fresh
map.选择身体部位和时长后，点击\"生成方案\"开始: After choosing body parts and a length, click "Generate routine" to start
map.拉伸动作随机生成器是一款纯前端在线工具，根据您选择的身体部位和训练时长，智能随机: The Random Stretch Routine Generator is a pure front-end online tool that intelligently generates a complete stretch routine based on the body parts and session length you choose. Each generation differs, helping enrich your stretching workouts.
map.纯前端处理，无需注册，数据不上传: Pure front-end processing, no registration, no data upload
map.4种时长选择，5~20分钟灵活适配: 4 length options, flexible from 5 to 20 minutes
map.每次随机生成，告别重复训练: Randomly generated each time, no more repetitive training
map.一键复制方案文本，方便记录分享: One-click copy of the routine text for easy recording and sharing
map.久坐办公间隙放松: Relaxation during breaks from prolonged sitting
map.按部位生成计划：勾选需要拉伸的身体部位（肩颈、腰背、腿、全身等），工具从动作库筛: Generate a plan by body part: tick the body parts you want to stretch (shoulders/neck, lower back, legs, full body, etc.) and the tool filters matching movements from its library.
map.按时长填满训练：设定总时长（如 10 分钟），工具为每个选中部位至少安排 1 个: Fill the session by length: set a total length (e.g. 10 minutes); the tool schedules at least 1 movement for each selected body part and then randomly cycles to fill until the target length is reached.
map.随机多样性与可复现：每次生成在选中部位内随机组合，避免单调；可「重新生成」换一套: Random variety and reproducibility: each generation combines randomly within the selected parts to avoid monotony; you can "regenerate" for a different set or copy the plan text for reference on the go.
map.算例：选「肩颈 + 腰部」、时长 10 分钟: Example: select "shoulders/neck + lower back", length 10 minutes
map.目标时长 = 10 × 60 = 600 秒。第一轮每个部位各取 1 个动作（如: Target length = 10 × 60 = 600 seconds. The first round takes 1 movement per body part (e.g. shoulders/neck 45s, lower back 50s), then cycles through the selected parts' libraries (each movement about 30-60s) until the total approaches 600s, allowing a ±30s deviation.
map.动作来自内置拉伸动作库（名称、部位、建议时长、要点说明）。仍属通用健身参考，伤痛: The movements come from a built-in stretch library (name, body part, suggested duration, key points). They remain general fitness references; people with injuries or illnesses should follow medical advice and avoid forcing a stretch.
map.首轮保证每个选中部位至少出现 1 个；后续循环随机补充，可能出现重复。可点「重新: The first round guarantees at least 1 movement per selected body part; later cycles fill randomly and may repeat. Click "regenerate" for a different combination, or trim it yourself.
